about_the_game:
Sky World 64 is a nostalgic, cozy-themed sandbox game that requires you to start the game with very few resources, but with the help of your fairy companion Trixie, you can turn your small island into a world bursting with life! Completing a set of tasks will ensure your game’s progression. 

You wake up in a strange world where there’s nothing but an abyss of sky and a floating island. You are greeted by a friendly fairy named Trixie, who needs help turning this empty world into a beautiful place. By agreeing to help her, you are required to gather the few resources from the island and give them to her, and in return, she can create something larger for you that can help with your progress. Together, you both will be able to turn the sky world into a place you’ll never forget!

  • Crafting is a crucial aspect of your progress. Finding any resources in your world can be used to make something greater!

  • Collecting XP will allow you to level up and grow your island larger while also unlocking many new features along the way!

  • Growing plants and farming crops is important to your progression, as well as tending to animals and studying nature!

  • Combat enemies to defend yourself while also using them to farm special resources!

  • Constructing machines can help you automate your tasks.

  • There are all four seasons of the year, which will change the world and events around you. You can even start the game in whatever season you wish, which will require different strategies to progress!

  • There's lots more special features to look forward to within the game!

There are 4 different types of classes to choose from! Each one will start the game differently, changing your strategy through each playthrough while also doubling XP for that specific class, depending on what task you complete.

 

  • The Naturalist class is the study of nature and all its surroundings. From planting and growing trees to studying wildlife such as birds, frogs, and other related creatures.

  • The Farmer class is, of course, all about farming. From growing crops to raising animals, you’ll be able to do just about everything a farmer does.

  • The Warrior class is all about combat. You will be able to create a monster farm to gather special resources and forge several different weapons.

  • The Engineer class dives heavily into the construction of machines and energy management. By mastering this class, you can have many types of machines that automate your work for you.

 

All class types can still be unlocked and played in your world, no matter which one you choose to start with.

Creative mode is a perfect way for players to try out different features in the game right from the start! With infinite amounts of resources at your disposal, you can create any type of world you desire!

The character pack feature allows you to customize the character models by going into the game files and changing the original design to any design you wish! You can also customize some of the music within the game!

Sky World 64 is a real passion project of mine and is the game I dreamed of making for years. I’m so excited to finally share it with the world, and I hope you enjoy it as much as I enjoy working on it!

  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 9400M or equivalent

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11
  • Processor: Intel(R) Celeron(R) N4000 CPU @ 1.10GHz (2 CPUs), ~1.1GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel(R) UHD Graphics 600
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 150 MB available space

short_description: Take a trip to Nostalgia Land in this cozy themed sandbox game that harkens back to the 64-bit era. This survival experience takes heavy inspiration from Minecraft’s Skyblock, where you start on a floating island with minimal resources and, over time, can turn your island into a world full of life!
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, Czech, Greek, Indonesian, Japanese, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Spanish - Latin America, Filipino
